metadata.title: Finflow - All-in-One Finance Management
metadata.description: Streamline your finances with Finflow. Budget management, invoicing, expense tracking, and more for individuals and businesses.

hero.title: Finance management,
hero.description: All-in-one platform for budgeting, invoicing, expense tracking, and financial reporting. Built for individuals, tailored for businesses. 500MB free storage included.

profiles.title: Tailored for your needs
profiles.description: Whether you're managing personal finances or running a business, Finflow adapts to you.

individual.title: Individual
individual.description: Track personal expenses, set budgets, and manage your financial goals with ease.

business.title: Business / Association
business.description: Complete financial management with invoicing, project budgets, and legal compliance.

features.title: Everything you need to manage finances
features.description: Powerful features designed to give you complete control over your financial life.

budget.title: Budget Management
budget.description: Create and track budgets with visual breakdowns. Set limits, get alerts, and stay on top of spending.

invoice.title: Invoice System
invoice.description: Create professional invoices, track payments, export to PDF, and send automated reminders.

expense.title: Expense Tracking
expense.description: Log expenses instantly, categorize transactions, and attach receipts for justification.

book.title: Smart Book System
book.description: A powerful spreadsheet interface for financial data. Link entries to invoices and expenses.

connected.title: Connected Data
connected.description: Link invoices to expenses to book entries. Everything connected in one place.

storage.title: Document Storage
storage.description: 500MB free storage for receipts, certificates, and justification documents.

bookSystem.title: Your financial data, beautifully organized
bookSystem.description: A powerful, customizable spreadsheet interface designed specifically for financial management. Link entries directly to invoices, expenses, and documents.
features: Export to Excel, PDF, or CSV

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.description: Start free, upgrade when you need more. No hidden fees.

testimonials.title: Loved by thousands
testimonials.description: See what our users have to say about Finflow.

items.quote: Finflow completely transformed how I manage my freelance finances. The invoicing system alone saved me hours every month.
items.author: Sarah Chen

items.quote: As an association treasurer, the legal compliance features are invaluable. Everything we need in one place.
items.author: Marcus Johnson

items.quote: The book system is incredible. It's like Excel but actually designed for finance. I can link everything together.
items.author: Emma Rodriguez

cta.title: Ready to take control of your finances?
cta.description: Join thousands of individuals and businesses already using Finflow to simplify their financial management.
